subtitle_zh: 白隘口观光铁路之旅，就从阿拉斯加的史凯威开始。
subtitle_en: White Pass Scenic Train Ride begins in Skagway, Alaska.
notes: start; single location; segment 1/1; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 列车从海平面的史凯威出发，开始向白隘口一路爬升。
subtitle_en: From sea level, the train begins climbing toward White Pass.
notes: Mile 0.0: Skagway - Sea Level; double location; segment 1/1; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 这里是白隘口铁路的维修基地，
subtitle_en: This is the White Pass railway maintenance base,
notes: Mile 2.0: Maintenance Shops; double location; segment 1/3; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 机车和客车都在这里检修，
subtitle_en: where locomotives and passenger cars are inspected and repaired
notes: Mile 2.0: Maintenance Shops; double location; segment 2/3; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 为穿越山区做好准备。
subtitle_en: before they are ready to cross the mountains.
notes: Mile 2.0: Maintenance Shops; double location; segment 3/3; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 到达丹佛地区后，
subtitle_en: After reaching Denver,
notes: Mile 5.8: Denver - 402FT; double location; segment 1/3; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 列车跨过史凯威河东支流。
subtitle_en: the train crosses the east fork of the Skagway River.
notes: Mile 5.8: Denver - 402FT; double location; segment 2/3; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 附近的丹佛冰川步道，通往更高处的山地。
subtitle_en: Nearby, the Denver Glacier trail leads higher into the mountains.
notes: Mile 5.8: Denver - 402FT; double location; segment 3/3; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 这里是克利夫顿铁路点。列车沿着史凯威河谷前进，铁路两旁是茂密的绿色山坡。
subtitle_en: Clifton is a small railway point beside the green Skagway River valley.
notes: Mile 8.7: Clifton - 849FT; double location; segment 1/1; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 远处岩壁上曾写着
subtitle_en: The distant canyon wall once carried the words
notes: Mile 8.8: Buchanan Rock - 849FT; double location; segment 1/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: “和布坎南一起前往阿拉斯加”。
subtitle_en: "On to Alaska with Buchanan."
notes: Mile 8.8: Buchanan Rock - 849FT; double location; segment 2/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 布坎南男孩旅行团曾年年来到这里，
subtitle_en: The Buchanan Boys travel group came here year after year,
notes: Mile 8.8: Buchanan Rock - 849FT; double location; segment 3/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 让这块标语成为经典景点。
subtitle_en: making this sign a classic landmark.
notes: Mile 8.8: Buchanan Rock - 849FT; double location; segment 4/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 新娘面纱瀑布发源于
subtitle_en: Bridal Veil Falls begins in the glaciers
notes: Mile 11.5: Bridal Veil Falls - 1334FT; single location; segment 1/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 克利夫兰山和克利福德山的冰川。
subtitle_en: of Mount Cleveland and Mount Clifford.
notes: Mile 11.5: Bridal Veil Falls - 1334FT; single location; segment 2/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 白色水流沿山壁倾泻而下，
subtitle_en: White water pours down the rock wall
notes: Mile 11.5: Bridal Veil Falls - 1334FT; single location; segment 3/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 像一层飘动的面纱。
subtitle_en: like a drifting veil.
notes: Mile 11.5: Bridal Veil Falls - 1334FT; single location; segment 4/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_en: On August 3, 1898,

subtitle_en: two railway workers died in a blasting accident.
notes: Mile 10.4: Black Cross Rock - 1090FT; double location; segment 3/4; absolute video-relative timing.

subtitle_zh: 岩石上的黑色十字架就是对他们的纪念。
subtitle_en: The black cross on the rock honors their memory.
notes: Mile 10.4: Black Cross Rock - 1090FT; double location; segment 4/4; absolute video-relative timing.
